notes.title: Fix Update 2025/08/25
notes.notes:
◆Bug Fixes  

・Corrected the school signboard display.  

・Removed the strange door in the schoolyard (which appeared during the noise removal event).  

・Fixed an issue where switching characters upon the third character's (Yuki)加入 caused a malfunction resulting in remote control mode.  

・Fixed an issue where the game became unplayable due to loud train noises and announcements when no playable characters were available.

• Changed so that you can no longer remove the controllable character or all characters from the party composition

• Fixed an issue where you could no longer pick up your bag after sitting on a train while holding it

• Fixed an issue where you couldn't put down desks or items (added explanations such as pressing the R stick to the menu screen's notes)

• Fixed an issue where you couldn't escape after walking onto the tracks and getting stuck in the train's driver's seat

• Added operation instructions to the menu screen's notes

• Fixed the method for clearing the noise removal event

◆Map-related

• Placed convenience store staff

• Installed a supermarket in the Matsunomiya area (no functionality)

• Changed LOD (adjusts model detail based on camera distance) to be more detailed even at longer distances

◆Character operation

• Slightly adjusted character collision detection and height detection
